title: Controllers and control systems
intro: Controllers and control systems must match the functions, sensors and interfaces of the application. Dimensions, operation and integration into the equipment also matter when selecting a suitable unit.

products.title: Temperature controllers
products.text: A temperature controller measures temperature and controls the associated process. Its sensor input, control behavior and outputs must match the heating or cooling application.
selectionParameters: What temperature needs to be measured and controlled?
Which sensor type and control input are planned?
Which outputs and control functions are required?
Which dimensions, operating functions and interfaces are specified?

products.title: Refrigeration controllers
products.text: A refrigeration controller matches temperature control to the functions of the refrigeration equipment. Sensors, outputs and operation are considered alongside the required operating functions.
selectionParameters: Which refrigeration application and operating functions are planned?
Which temperatures need to be measured and which sensors are required?
Which outputs does the equipment need?
Which dimensions, interfaces and operating requirements apply?

products.title: Control systems
products.text: A control system connects equipment functions with the attached sensors and actuators. The required inputs, outputs and operating sequences form the basis for selection.
selectionParameters: Which equipment functions and operating sequences should the control system handle?
Which sensors, actuators and signals need to be connected?
Which interfaces and operating functions are required?
Which dimensions and environmental conditions need to be considered?

products.title: Accessories
products.text: Accessories are selected to suit the controller or control system and its installation. The existing equipment, connections and required function provide the starting point.
selectionParameters: Which controller or control system requires accessories?
Which function needs to be added?
Which connections and interfaces need to be compatible?
What requirements arise from mounting and the operating environment?

title: Sensors and probes
intro: Temperature probes must suit the measurement range, environment and connected equipment. Probe design, cable and connector determine how the probe is integrated into the application.

products.title: NTC probes
products.text: An NTC probe needs a characteristic curve and connection that match the measurement or control input. Its design is selected according to the measurement location and operating conditions.
selectionParameters: Which NTC characteristic curve does the connected equipment require?
Which temperature range and measurement location are planned?
Which probe design and mounting method suit the installation?
Which cable length, connector and environmental conditions apply?

products.title: PTC probes
products.text: A PTC probe needs its characteristic curve to match the signal processing system. The measurement location, installation and connection determine which design suits the application.
selectionParameters: Which PTC characteristic curve and signal processing system are planned?
Which temperatures should the probe measure?
Which probe design and mounting method are required?
Which cable, connector and operating conditions are specified?

products.title: PT100 probes
products.text: A PT100 probe is considered together with the compatible measurement input and connection type. The measurement location, temperature range and measurement requirements determine the appropriate design.
selectionParameters: Is the measurement input designed for a PT100 probe?
Which connection type is planned?
Which temperature range and measurement requirements apply?
Which probe design, cable and mounting method suit the measurement location?

products.title: PT1000 probes
products.text: A PT1000 probe requires a compatible measurement or control input. Connection, probe design and cable are selected to suit the measurement location and operating conditions.
selectionParameters: Is the connected input designed for a PT1000 probe?
Which connection type and cable are planned?
Which temperature range and measurement requirements apply?
Which probe design, mounting method and environmental conditions need to be considered?

title: Heating elements
intro: Heating applications require power, geometry and mounting to be considered together. Temperature control and conditions at the installation site are equally important.

products.title: Tubular heating elements
products.text: Tubular heating elements require the heating application, geometry and installation to be matched. The electrical design and operating conditions determine the remaining requirements.
selectionParameters: Which heating application and power requirement are planned?
Which geometry and installation space are available?
How will the heating element be mounted and electrically connected?
Which temperatures, environmental conditions and control method apply during operation?

products.title: Heating foils
products.text: For heating foils, the surface to be heated and integration into the component are central to selection. Power, mounting and temperature control are matched to the application.
selectionParameters: Which surface and geometry need to be heated?
Which power requirement and electrical supply are planned?
How will the heating foil be mounted and connected?
Which operating temperatures, environmental conditions and control method are specified?

products.title: Heating cables
products.text: A heating cable is selected according to the heating application and planned installation. Length, electrical design and cable routing must suit the application and temperature control.
selectionParameters: Which heating application and power requirement are known?
Which length and cable route are planned?
Which electrical supply and connection type apply?
Which temperatures, operating conditions and control method need to be considered?

title: Pressure and switching devices
intro: Switching points, measurement ranges and connections must suit the application. When replacing or adapting a component, the technical characteristics and installation conditions of the existing part are relevant.

products.title: Pressure switches
products.text: A pressure switch converts a defined pressure condition into a switching action. Pressure range, switching point and connections must suit the monitored application.
selectionParameters: Which pressure range and switching point are planned?
Which switching function is required?
Which pressure and electrical connections are specified?
Which installation conditions and medium need to be considered?

products.title: Differential pressure switches
products.text: A differential pressure switch responds to the pressure difference between two points. The required switching point and connections are matched to the monitoring application.
selectionParameters: Which differential pressure range and switching point are required?
Which switching function is planned?
Which connections and installation conditions are present?
Which medium and operating conditions apply?

products.title: Thermal switches
products.text: A thermal switch responds to a defined temperature condition. Switching behavior, electrical integration and conditions at the measurement location are considered during selection.
selectionParameters: At which temperature should switching occur?
Which switching and reset behavior is required?
Which electrical integration and connection type are planned?
Which design, mounting method and operating conditions apply?
